runs.name: Plain CE Baseline
runs.notes: Learns basic corridor-following but fails at critical fork decisions due to equal weight dilution.

runs.name: Tesseract Loss (Sparse)
runs.notes: Loss structure alone improves success rate by 6.7% but exhibits a tradeoff with path optimality at low data scale.

runs.name: All-Position BFS (Dense)
runs.notes: Denser multi-direction training. Plain CE baseline collapses to 36.67% on this distribution, highlighting Tesseract's robustness.

runs.name: Extended Training
runs.notes: Extended training and Cosine Annealing allows the model to digest structural signal and achieve perfect test success.

runs.name: Second Seed (Final)
runs.notes: Continued training on a second seed resolves the optimality tradeoff, raising both optimal rate and efficiency.
